<div style="width:{{{width|16em}}};">
{{#ifeq: {{{header}}} | no | <p><big>'''{{#expr:( {{{1|<noinclude>2</noinclude>0}}} / {{{total|100}}} ) * 100 round 1}}%'''</big> {{{text|completed <small>(estimate)</small>}}}</p> |  }}
